lesson: TAXONOMY SPECIES 6: a guard keyed on a signal that renews every tick cannot fire; key guards on the sub-signal the mechanic actually moves. Same family as species 5 (pre-treatment echo): certification/guarding must bind to the observable the mechanism moves, not a convenient superset.
